title: chore: unify all package versions to 3.0.8
body:
Root monorepo `package.json` was at `3.0.7` while all 38 other packages were already at `3.0.8`. ROADMAP.md had stale version numbers across the board.

- **`package.json`** — `3.0.7` → `3.0.8`
- **`ROADMAP.md`** — Updated header version and all 34 entries in Package Status Matrix to `3.0.8`
- **`.changeset/unify-versions.md`** — Patch changeset for `@objectstack/spec`
